initial_goals: AL: complete model and physical-scale bridge
AM: evaluate a complete-model stability interval
AN: compare two specified bulk limits
later_goals: Select only after AL, AM and AN each have two reviewed loops; inherited AO/AP are proposals, not commitments.
second_loop_rule: Select after previous loop's independent outputs and skeptical review; preserve insufficient outcomes.
review_limit: Agents share model ancestry and inherited premises. This is not external human peer review, formal proof checking, or experimental replication.
naming: Hruday/HNM are project aliases with stable legacy mappings. Existing external theorem names, authors, sources and mathematical notation remain attributed. No literature priority follows from renaming.
scope: Accepted historical records and source-bound gates remain immutable; a new integrated manuscript and current website supersede presentation only.
validation: Data validation workflow for counts, priority table, units, claim-to-evidence mapping and published presentation. Rank is qualitative research utility, not a score of Clay-problem completion.
stop: Stop scientific production after ten reviewed loops. Repairs, source searches, builds, release replays and paper/site QA add no loops.
